items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you work with John Handy? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, once, once or twice, yeah.

ctx.x: It was timing Uncle Tom then. Because those guys, man, see at that time I was weighing about a hundred and forty-two pounds. And these guys weighed well over three hundred, there were three of them. And there was nobody around, it was about three o'clock in the morning. But they put a whipping on her.
Oh, I wanted to show you something, this is a, maybe you can comment on it, it's from an interview here with John Handy. Did you work with John Handy? Captain John Handy?
Oh, once, once or twice, yeah.
